page.agentArgsSubtitle: Same on Linux and Windows. Use these if you run the binary manually or in portable mode.
page.webViewerSubtitle: Runs directly in the browser — you're already on it.

osTabs.linuxNote: The command below installs the agent as a systemd service. Desktop packages (.deb/.rpm/.AppImage) install normally — they are viewer + host.
osTabs.windowsNote: Run the command in PowerShell as Administrator. The desktop package (.msi/.exe) is viewer + host.
osTabs.androidNote: Install the APK and open the app. On Android it's viewer only.

agentArgs.server: PeerDesk server base URL (the API and signaling are derived from it).
agentArgs.apiKey: Registration token generated from the dashboard (used once). The binary flag is --api-key.
agentArgs.password: Manually sets the connection password (otherwise one is generated).
agentArgs.silent: Writes to a log file instead of stdout (used by the service).
agentArgs.portable: Stores the config next to the binary (portable mode).
agentArgs.getId: Prints the peer ID and exits.
agentArgs.resetPassword: Generates a new password, prints it, and exits.
agentArgs.installService: Installs as a systemd / Windows service.
